summary: Verified thermal-friendly receipt fix for C80BT 80mm printer. Backend 20/20 pytest passed (6 new dedicated tests for thermal styling). Frontend flow verified: Sales page shows CETAK NOTA button (text + icon, blue #002FA7), click opens receipt window at /api/sales/{id}/receipt. Runtime computed styles confirm ALL text renders rgb(0,0,0) pure black with font-weight ≥700 and Arial family — no gray fallbacks in receipt content. Regression: /api/sales, /api/sales/stats/today still healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sales_receipt_html template is embedded inline as a giant f-string (~90 lines). If more receipt variations/styles are added (e.g., A4 preview mode, different paper widths), move to a Jinja2 template file for maintainability.

server.py comment at line 4597 still says 'lebih tebal & terbaca dibanding Courier' — clarifies intent; harmless. Prior test regex 'Courier not in html' had to be relaxed to only match font-family declarations because the word appears in a comment.

@page CSS uses `size: 80mm auto` (correct for C80BT), but some browsers ignore custom @page in preview mode. The .toolbar hint already instructs user to set 'Margin: None' & 'Skala: 100%' — good UX safeguard.

toolbar .hint uses color:#333 which is fine because it is stripped from the print (toolbar has display:none in @media print). Verified via test_receipt_no_gray_colors_inside_receipt which excludes toolbar region.
Frontend Sales.jsx CETAK NOTA button uses inline Tailwind classes with hardcoded #002FA7 to match receipt toolbar button — consistent branding. Fine.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Thermal receipt fix VALIDATED. Key CSS assertions (backend_test): (a) font-family Arial/Helvetica/'Liberation Sans', no font-family Courier and no monospace, (b) body font-weight:700, .receipt * color:#000 !important, header/grand 900, (c) @page 80mm auto margin:0, .receipt width:72mm, (d) NO #222/#333/#666/#999/gray in .receipt block (toolbar .hint #333 tolerated), (e) full labels present: No. Nota, Tanggal, Kasir, Pelanggan, Telp, Subtotal, Diskon, TOTAL, Metode, Bayar, Kembali, Terima kasih, (f) TUNAI payment method uppercased, (g) print button with window.print() and #002FA7 blue. Frontend runtime verified via getComputedStyle(): receipt/addr/meta/item.mat/footer all render rgb(0,0,0) & weight >=700 & Arial family. Grand total weight=900. Since testing agent cannot physically print on C80BT, this is the strongest validation available; the fix should render dark & readable on thermal head. If user still reports pudar after this fix, direction is to check printer driver density (BOOST density in driver → 100%) and enable 'Background graphics' in browser print dialog (already hinted in .toolbar).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of pudar/blur thermal print: original template used 'Courier New' monospace (thin strokes → few dots hit thermal head), plus gray text tones (#222/#333/#999) that produced weaker heat pattern. Fix (validated): (1) switched to Arial sans-serif with thicker strokes, (2) forced font-weight 700 on ALL receipt text + 900 on headers/grand total via '.receipt, .receipt * { color:#000 !important; font-weight:700 }', (3) replaced dotted #999 separators with dashed #000 solid, (4) enforced @page 80mm size margin:0 and .receipt width 72mm for safe printable area on C80BT, (5) added user-visible hint about 'Margin:None, Skala:100%, Background graphics'. All 6 dedicated backend tests + runtime computed-style probes confirm the CSS renders as intended.
